title: tune-nccl-collectives-scheduling-and-kernel-sync-for-better-overlap-tensor-parallel
author: Arielle Park
description: Motivation: In multi-GPU tensor-parallel workloads we observed suboptimal overlap between NCCL collectives and device compute when kernels implicitly synchronize on the default stream. This PR tunes NCCL stream usage, reorders kernel launches to avoid unintended sync points, and updates the TP scheduling heuristics so bandwidth-bound collectives start earlier and compute kernels can stream concurrently. Changes include a small runtime API to request dedicated comm streams, a kernel-launch plan that avoids implicit default-stream barriers, KV-cache async scatter/gather optimizations, and a set of microbenchmarks. Expected impact is reduced p99 latency and improved throughput for multi-GPU inference (10-20% depending on model shape and sequence length).
commits: Add dedicated NCCL comm stream and registration in NcclManager
Introduce KernelLaunchPlan to decouple kernel order from default stream
Update TP scheduler heuristics to prioritize bandwidth-bound collectives
KV cache: async shard scatter/gather and lightweight completion fences
Add perf tests and docs for NCCL tuning
Address review feedback: tighten synchronization and add metrics
review_comments: Daniel Kim: Please explain why dedicated comm streams are safe with our current CUDA stream pool; worried about stream exhaustion on very large node counts.
Arielle Park (author): We allocate comm streams lazily per-device and fall back to default streams if the pool is exhausted; added accounting and a graceful fallback path in NcclManager.
Priya Singh: The kernel reorder looks good but add a comment about implicit default-stream synchronization introduced by some cuBLAS helpers — we should avoid mixing with our own stream launches.
Arielle Park: Added KernelLaunchPlan and comments; added unit that asserts no accidental default-stream sync in unit tests.
Luis Ortega: CI flake on perf test; looks like race in test harness. Please stabilize before merge.
Arielle Park: Fixed test harness to use CUDA events for fences and re-ran CI; perf test now stable.
release_notes: Performance: Improve multi-GPU tensor-parallel throughput/latency by tuning NCCL stream usage and scheduling. Introduces dedicated NCCL comm streams, KernelLaunchPlan to avoid default-stream syncs, and async KV-cache shard ops. See docs/perf/nccl_tuning.md for details and recommended config knobs.
